items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1959-11-17
items.q: Used to play a clarinet with us named Robeshow? ... He's a big clenny with Jack Hale-Band.

ctx.x: And Dolphine. And Bourbon, isn't it? Burbundi and Dauphine or Burgundi and Rambo? Yeah, Dauphine. Burbundi and Dauphine, yeah. Yeah, Dauphine. Yeah, Dauphine. Burbundi and Dauphine, yeah. Dauphine, I see it then.

She's very fair. Her name was Sadie Washington. She's living on this side of the person. Did she play music? No, she don't play music. Uptown, son. Oh, she's old, she's about four or five years old than me, you know. You used to have a real bright boy, you remember? Used to play a clarinet with us named Robeshow? Yeah, he's dead. What come of him? He's dead.
